hypothesis: W-R34 found a 4-bit synthetic accuracy disadvantage for symmetric reference quantization. Test its repeatability across four prospectively specified, mutually disjoint seed cohorts using exact frozen W-R34 development-only models and unchanged evaluation features, with no retraining on new cohorts.
freeze: Before first-use freeze 4 nonoverlapping 16-seed cohorts 1440..1503, fixed 4/2-bit precision, 3 generator families, 2 swap sites, paired labels, exact W-R34 model/training implementation and criteria. No reused historical heldout, no seed screening.
training: Train each asymmetric_refit and symmetric_refit once per bit depth using EXACT original W-R34 development-only 1184..1199; 1728 examples, 32 epochs, 16 weights+bias, no adjustments or new fitting. Training reconstructed deterministically from exact pinned W-R34 code, not a new qualification of a changed foundation.
primary: Report per-seed TP/TN/FP/FN, per-cell correct/total, identical-positive-negative counts and each of four cohort accuracy deltas (symmetric minus asymmetric), separately 4-bit and 2-bit. ROBUST_ASYMMETRIC_ADVANTAGE iff >=3 of 4 cohorts show <=-0.05 at 4-bit and pooled 4-bit delta <=-0.05. MIXED_TRANSFER iff 4-bit cohort deltas include both >0 and <0. NO_REPLICATION otherwise. Never tune thresholds after results.
controls: Independently specified heldout seeds; no overlap with W-R34 original dev1184..1199 or heldout1200..1215
Train/feature/prediction identity with pinned W-R34, no new sensors, classes, loss function, capacity, labels, or tuning
Include indistinguishable positive/negative pairs; do not discard scientific negatives or frame within-cohort data as independent source-birth evidence
One original frozen first-use result archived before one Go full regression and build; no accepted-ref mutation
claim_limit: Reproducibility of a synthetic 4-bit coding effect across new deterministic seeds; not independent real-world domain generalization.
